gameEventConstraints.name: arcade_growth_game_events_check1
gameEventConstraints.definition: CHECK (source = 'garden-battles'::text AND evidence_kind = 'completed-result'::text AND (game_id = 'arborist-trials'::text AND source_id ~~ 'trial:%'::text AND proof_digest IS NULL OR (game_id = ANY (ARRAY['garden-bot'::text, 'pvp'::text])) AND source_id ~~ 'battle:%'::text AND proof_digest IS NOT NULL) OR source = 'treeforce89'::text AND game_id = 'treeforce89'::text AND evidence_kind = 'authenticated-run-start'::text AND source_id ~ '^run:grove-[a-f0-9]{32}:0x[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text AND proof_digest IS NULL)

postflight.originalRunIndex: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX arcade_growth_treeforce_original_run_idx ON private.arcade_growth_game_events USING btree (split_part(source_id, ':'::text, 2)) WHERE (source = 'treeforce89'::text)
postflight.securityInterpretation: INFO-only RLS-without-policy findings are expected for deliberately private tables used only through the service role; no new public grant or security warning.

boundaries.productionAccess: Read-only catalog confirmation: all seven existing Daily Growth tables retain RLS.

review.status: One connection-string identity hardening recommendation sent to handler owner; no other auth or read-only boundary defect found.
review.finding: Pinned pg-connection-string 2.14.1 permits host/port/user/password query parameters to override URL authority. Reject non-allowlisted transport parameters before relying on the pinned URL identity.
review.knownBoundary: The game database and Supabase do not share an atomic transaction. The handler rereads the exact bearer/run after ownership verification immediately before the RPC; the RPC independently checks trusted expiry and a 15-second verification freshness window. This is authenticated participation, not authoritative proof of completed gameplay.
